title: H1: evening Coconala re-scan (ids > last screened); send under PG-1 (widened lane, ≤5/day)
detail: Scan new public requests (https://coconala.com/requests?recruiting=true&sort=new) since the last screened id (5323492 as of 10/13 19:04; the 10:00 h1-coconala-scan-1014 will advance it) on the WIDENED lane (PROPOSAL_KIT §2/§2.5). Send under PG-1 when conditions 1-7 hold, and log each. Cap: ≤5/day combined with CrowdWorks. Tip: list via in-page fetch + DOMParser, remove style/script before textContent, and fetch /requests/<id> in-page. Respect any Founder Coconala kill/pivot decision (10/15 check). On done: create the next evening scan (h1-coconala-scan-<MMDD>pm).
